verdict.rationale: Warp documents a REST API (with SDKs, pagination, API-key auth) that exposes the company's payroll data, plus MCP access so agents like Claude and ChatGPT can use Warp. That gives an agent a first-party way to pull payroll-related data. Nothing in the evidence shows a payroll journal or general-ledger endpoint, a journal export, or any accounting or ledger reconciliation feature. Missing for 10: documented payroll journal/GL entries endpoint or export, accounting-system or ledger integration, reconciliation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
